definitions.gloss: no photography; photography prohibited; no filming
definitions.explanation: A prohibition on taking photographs or recording video. Commonly seen on signs in museums, theaters, temples, and other locations where photography is restricted.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}です。
⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}になっている。
examples.english: Photography is not allowed inside the art museum.

examples.japanese: {撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}っている→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was a no-photography sign, but someone was taking photos with a camera anyway.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧ (photography, filming) and ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition). Commonly seen on signs at museums, temples, concert venues, and other locations. Many Japanese cultural sites restrict photography to protect artwork, maintain atmosphere, or respect privacy.

USAGE:
- ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧: art museums (often prohibit flash or all photography)
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧/⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧: shrines and temples (some areas restricted)
- ⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧: theaters and performance venues
- {試験会場|しけんかいじょう}: examination venues

RELATED PROHIBITION SIGNS:
- {録音禁止|ろくおんきんし}: no audio recording
- ⟦フラッシュ→フラッシュ：08811_furasshu⟧{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}: no flash photography
- {動画撮影禁止|どうがさつえいきんし}: no video recording
- SNS{投稿禁止|とうこうきんし}: no posting on social media

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please refrain from photography — more polite phrasing
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧NG: photography not OK — casual/informal
